text:
First Major GTA 6 Update Fixes a Feature You May Have Missed - IGN Daily Fix
In today's Daily Fix:

The first post-launch update for Grand Theft Auto 6 is now live for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Among several bug fixes is a patch to the game's weather system, or rather lack of one. The in-game dynamic weather system was supposed to mimic real Floridian weather patterns, but it appears the feature wasn't working as intended at launch. For many players, the weather wouldn't change, remaining clear or cloudy, or change very infrequently. The new patch fixes this so the weather can change at a more realistic cadence. In related news, Carly Rae Jepsen's acclaimed pop hit "Run Away with Me" from 2015 is seeing a boost in streaming activity after being featured in GTA 6. And it's not just a song on the radio; the tune plays at a pivotal moment in Chapter 1. And finally, Amazon Prime Video's God of War series has cast a veteran of the games in an important role.

Madden - Official Turduckens Clip (2026) Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale, Kathryn Hahn
Get a look at Turduckens Clip for Madden, a drama biography distributed by Amazon MGM Studios. Learn how to cut a Turducken in Madden, in theaters and streaming on Prime Video now.

Inspired by the life of a beloved American icon, MADDEN chronicles John Madden's incredible journey alongside best friend and true original Al Davis – from a Super Bowl-winning partnership with the Raiders, to becoming football’s most recognizable voice, to building the worldwide Madden NFL video game. MADDEN is the celebration of a brilliant mind whose once-in-a-century spirit and personality, partnership with his daring wife Virginia, lifelong friendships, and infectious love of people and football transcended the world of sports.

Madden stars Nicolas Cage, Christian Bale, Kathryn Hahn, Matt Medrano, Sienna Miller, and more. The film is directed by David O. Russell and written by David O. Russell and Cambron Clark.

Madden is in theaters and streaming on Prime Video now.
